brand.claim: Reports season finales and complete seasons from Sonarr.

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Enter the API key Finalarr was started with (FINALARR_API_KEY).

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.emptyBody: Connect Sonarr first and pick the series you want to follow. Airing seasons, upcoming finales and the latest reports will then show up here.
dashboard.nothingAiring: No followed season is airing right now.
dashboard.noContinue: Nothing unwatched in series you started.

series.title: Series
series.emptyBody: Once a Sonarr instance is connected, all its series are listed here, ready to follow.

events.title: Events
events.emptyBody: Every report Finalarr sends ends up here, with its delivery status per channel.
events.noDelivery: not delivered to any channel yet

about.title: About Finalarr
about.creditsIntro: Finalarr shows data from these services; which ones are active is under Settings → Data sources.
about.tmdbNotice: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
about.licences: Licences of the bundled software and fonts

error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute.
error.network: Finalarr cannot be reached right now.
error.generic: Something went wrong. The log has the details.

season.label: Season {{n}}
season.title: Season {{n}}
season.tvdbMissing: Sonarr does not know this season yet.
season.disputed: Sonarr lists {{sonarr}} episodes, AniList says {{anilist}}. "Complete" waits for the larger number until you set it via ⋯.
season.notFollowed: You do not follow this series. Follow it so Finalarr fetches its episodes and sends reports.
season.disputedExternal: Sonarr lists {{sonarr}} episodes, {{source}} says {{other}}. "Complete" waits for the larger number until you set it via ⋯.

check.refreshQueued: Sync with Sonarr has been started.

rules.title: Rules
rules.overrideHint: Replaces what Sonarr and AniList say. Leave it empty to let Finalarr decide again.
rules.renotifyOnGrowth: Report again when a complete season grows
rules.renotifyOnGrowthHint: E.g. when TVDB later adds a second cour to the season.
rules.renotifyAfterFileLoss: Report again when a deleted file comes back
rules.renotifyAfterFileLossHint: Off: upgrades in Sonarr do not cause a second report.
rules.respectMonitoringDefault: Ignore unmonitored episodes for new series
rules.stableRuns: Syncs with an unchanged count before "complete"
rules.newsFeeds: Report headlines (LiveChart, Anime News Network) about followed series
rules.newsFeedsHint: Matched strictly by title; a hint with a link, not an announcement.
rules.seriesNewsWeb: Web news search for every series (Google News)
rules.seriesNewsWebHint: Sends the series title to Google News to show recent headlines.

anilist.missingHint: No AniList mapping found – episode counts come from Sonarr only.
anilist.pick: Pick up to four entries (split cours: all parts).
anilist.unavailable: AniList cannot be reached right now. Try again in a minute.
anilist.savedLater: Saved. AniList will be asked on the next run.

parts.title: Parts (split cour)
parts.asSeasons: Report parts as seasons of their own
parts.asSeasonsHint: Useful when months pass between the cours.

channel.title: Channels
channel.empty: No channel yet. Without one, Finalarr records events but sends nothing.
channel.name: Name
channel.quietHint: Reports wait during this time and arrive afterwards (container time zone).
channel.keepSecret: Leave empty to keep the stored value

onboarding.title: Setup
onboarding.s1Body: You find the address and API key in Sonarr under Settings → General.
onboarding.s2Body: Finalarr only reports series you follow. Follow every monitored series with one click or pick them one by one.
onboarding.s3Body: Where should the reports go? Send a test message first.
onboarding.syncRunning: First sync with Sonarr is running …
onboarding.webhookWaiting: No webhook call yet. Save the webhook in Sonarr and click “Test”.

instance.title: Sonarr instances
instance.name: Name
instance.rotateConfirm: Create a new token? The old webhook URL in Sonarr stops working.
instance.deleteConfirm: Remove instance "{{name}}" and all its series from Finalarr?
instance.webhookHint: Add it in Sonarr under Settings → Connect → Webhook, method POST, events "On Import", "On Upgrade", "On Series Add" and "On Episode File Delete".
instance.sonarr_unreachable: Sonarr cannot be reached at this address.

system.title: System
system.apiKeyHint: Change the API key through FINALARR_API_KEY and a restart; all sessions end then.
system.overdueHint: No successful run for two intervals

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.empty: Nothing to wait for this month.
calendar.scopeHint: Only series you follow. Switch single series off on their page.
calendar.feedHint: Add this address to your calendar: Google Calendar → "From URL", Apple Calendar → "New calendar subscription", Outlook → "From the internet". The address is secret – anyone who has it can see your calendar.
calendar.rotateConfirm: Create a new address? Existing subscriptions stop working.

news.title: News
news.empty: No news about this series yet.
news.webOff: Web news search is switched off in the rules.
news.webError: News search cannot be reached right now.

waiting.title: What you're waiting for
waiting.airing: Season {{season}} is airing: {{have}} of {{expected}} episodes are here.
waiting.missing_one: Season {{season}}: {{count}} aired episode is still missing from the library.
waiting.missing_other: Season {{season}}: {{count}} aired episodes are still missing from the library.
waiting.disputed: Season {{season}}: Sonarr and AniList name different episode counts ({{expected}} and {{anilist}}).
waiting.count_unknown: Season {{season}} is airing; the episode count is not known yet ({{have}} here).
waiting.renewed_open: Season {{season}} is announced; the date is still open.
waiting.renewed_open_sequel: {{sequel}} is announced; the date is still open.
waiting.complete_no_sequel: Season {{season}} is complete. No sequel has been announced yet.
waiting.nothing_known: Nothing known yet. Finalarr will tell you as soon as there is news.

extras.watchRegion: Streaming offers in {{region}}: data by JustWatch via TMDB
extras.trailerNote: Loads the video from YouTube (youtube-nocookie.com) only after the click.
extras.errors: Some sources could not be reached.

sources.intro: These are the services Finalarr asks. Each one can be switched off; Finalarr only sends them ids or titles, never your Sonarr address, keys or library.
sources.needsKeyHint: Without a key this source is off. Keys come as environment variables (see the docs).
sources.coreHint: Without this source, anime episode counts and split cours are missing.

anilist.use: Episode counts, split cours and sequels for anime; next episode, trailer, streaming links.
anilist.terms: Free for non-commercial use; no bulk harvesting.

fribb.use: Maps Sonarr seasons (TVDB) to AniList entries; downloaded weekly.
fribb.terms: No licence stated; Finalarr only downloads the list and does not redistribute it.

jikan.use: Second source for announced anime sequels.
jikan.terms: Unofficial MyAnimeList API (Jikan, MIT); data from MyAnimeList.

tvmaze.use: Spots renewed series early; channel and next episode.
tvmaze.terms: Data under CC BY-SA 4.0; Finalarr links back to TVmaze as the source.

tmdb.use: Another source for season announcements; where to watch (per country) and trailers.
tmdb.terms: TMDB API terms with logo and notice; streaming offers by JustWatch.

animeschedule.use: English dub dates and delay notes.
animeschedule.terms: Visible link to AnimeSchedule.net; no commercial use, no AI training.

livechart.use: Anime headlines that name a followed series.
livechart.terms: RSS feed: headline with a link to the article.

animenewsnetwork.use: Anime headlines that name a followed series.
animenewsnetwork.terms: RSS feed: headline with a link to the article.

anime2you.use: German anime headlines that name a followed series.
anime2you.terms: RSS feed: headline with a link to the article.

crunchyroll.use: English anime headlines that name a followed series.
crunchyroll.terms: RSS feed: headline with a link to the article.

google_news.use: News box on the series page: searches for the series title.
google_news.terms: RSS search; Finalarr only sends the title.

youtube.use: Trailer on the series page, loaded only after a click (youtube-nocookie.com).

media.intro: Connect Emby, Jellyfin or Plex. Finalarr reads what the selected people watched and follows those series automatically. It stores only which episodes were watched, no history.
media.name: Name

tokenHint.plex: Plex: the server owner's X-Plex-Token (support article “Finding an authentication token”).

media.unmatched_one: {{count}} watched series matches no Sonarr series
media.unmatched_other: {{count}} watched series match no Sonarr series
media.unmatchedHint: They are missing in Sonarr or the media server knows no TVDB id.
media.unreachable: Media server unreachable or key rejected: {{message}}
media.removeConfirm: Remove media server "{{name}}"? What its users watched is deleted with it.

watch.title: Watched
watch.nobody: Nobody has watched this series yet.
watch.unwatched_one: {{count}} episode on disk is still unwatched; next up {{next}}.
watch.unwatched_other: {{count}} episodes on disk are still unwatched; next up {{next}}.

modeHint.auto: Finalarr follows as soon as someone watches the series.
modeHint.never: Finalarr never follows this series, even if someone watches it.

watch.correctHint: Tip: click an episode to correct its watched state.

count.title: Where does the episode count come from?
count.decisionUnknown: Finalarr does not know the episode count yet and holds back “complete”.
count.disputedHint: The sources name different numbers. “Complete” waits for the larger one until you set one via ⋯ on the season.
count.unmonitored: {{count}} of them unmonitored, they do not count

tracker.title: Watched
tracker.empty: Connect Emby, Jellyfin or Plex and pick whose viewing counts:
tracker.undated_one: {{count}} episode from the first sync has no date; it counts only in the total.
tracker.undated_other: {{count}} episodes from the first sync have no date; they count only in the total.
tracker.unknownDetail: Episode list unknown: Finalarr knows the episodes of followed series only.

page.crash: An error in the interface stopped it. Your data is not affected. Reload the page or switch to another one.
page.notFound: Finalarr has no page at this address.
